comment:
Have to agree with the last rater.
Her classes are a lot of qualifications and repetition and posing. Literally a waste of time. 3/10
I did not like this class and I was really interested in the material and listened and read. Sing picks favorites and some students are concerned with her self presentation.

Dr. Singh is pretty cool and I would always enjoy hearing what she had to say about the texts we would read. I took this course as my English gen-ed, and although her style of teaching differs greatly from the one I learned in high school, you actually DO learn a lot and the class isn't just another gen-ed. She is a tough grader but also awesome.

she is extremely intellectual and open minded. she was funny and also really cares about societal issues. you had to read for each class but there was only a couple of papers and one presentation we had to do. i really enjoyed her class and I felt as if I actually took something from her teaching.

I have to differ with some ratings as the new term is coming up. Singh is a nice person, but this class didn't work for myself and some others I know. it is not really an open forum in which case it could have been amazing but she is pretty cult like toward herself and inappropriately presenting a lot of the time

Julietta is so intelligent and just knows so much about all of the books we read. She gives background information or different perspectives that make you think about the book in whole new ways. I would only say that sometimes this talking takes up most of the class and students don't get as many chances to add their own ideas/perspectives.

She is absolutely amazing! You will have to work for your grade but she is always available outside of class and is willing to read your essays and give feedback before you turn it in. All of the grading requirements are clear and she is a really fair grader. You can tell she really cares about the students as people. I highly recommend this class!

Dr. Singh is one of the best professors I have ever had the privilege of having. She cares about her students, is eloquent and informed in her topics, and is socially conscious (woke) and careful to exercise that in her classes. This is one of my favorite classes ever. Highly, HIGHLY recommend. Just do the work and you will love this course!

I LOVE Julietta so much! She's incredible as a professor and she's so great at explaining things. She'll totally engage with you if you disagree with her and doesn't ever take marks for that. She's a really fair grader and a lot of fun. 10/10. Would recommend.

One of the best professors I have had thus far.   Assigns well-known novels, poetry, short pieces, interesting TED talks.  Loved the class discussions--I was challenged to question and defend my arguments.  Always willing to work with you outside of class on writing.  Still have wonderful discussions with her on a variety of topics! Great person!!

I have had Dr. Singh for 3-4 classes in college and I think that the value of taking her class becomes evident as you continue your academic carrer. The material is not hard but the discussion and class participation segments can become challanging depending on the caliber of students that are in your class. Strongly recomned for GenEd and Majors

I've taken 3 courses with Dr. Singh now, and she has stayed consistently engaging, helpful, and caring. She is responsive to student emails, and will make the essay-writing process easier if you take the extra step to ask her questions. As her courses are typically essay-based (with short weekly reader responses sometimes), this is important. 10/10

Dr. Singh is a very cool professor. She's very energetic and eager to talk about the novels, and contextualizes books in order to bring a greater understanding to the course. My main qualm is that she does not allow guide discussions when class discussion starts to go off the rails. More structure would be nice.

Great professor with some really interesting insights! She is not afraid to admit when she is wrong, and has often changed her opinions on certain texts based off the discussions. Overall a really really interesting course!
just got my grade for the first time all semester.... glad i had a chance to improve

You have professors at UR and then you have Dr. Singh. We almost cried the last day of classes because the course (Global Women Writers) had been so fantastic. I promise you this will be one of the best classes you take. The material is great and she is even better as a professor and as a person. She's beyond engaging, honest, fair, and hilarious.

I took her course for a gen ed requirement, but now I'm considering an English major. Really engaging and fun teacher who makes you look at texts in a unique and different and interesting way. If you respect her by doing your assignments and participating in class, she'll respect you and it'll be a good time. She's really funny, too.
Very helpful and explains the material in a way that all students can understand.  Food for Thought was interesting, especially since she taught it.

Dr. Singh is one of my favorite professors at UR. She really cares about her students understanding the material and learning to write well. Definitely take one of her courses if you can - she makes the reading material interesting and is really down to earth.

I found this professor extremely captivating, helpful, receptive, and warm. This class reminded me of how much I love to learn, and her personal interest in my classmates' and my development has already changed the way I view my education and future. I found her fair, communicative, and well-established, even though it was her first year.
OK, but the class is overstuffed and not informative enough.

Very good teacher that knows her stuff. I liked the way she controlled the discussions. Sometimes she came off a little rude, but I guess all teachers do. She grades fairly, but I feel that if you do not focus on what she is looking for in "your opinion" based responses, she will take off points. The reading assigned was a bit much at times.
